about: The collision audit's CI limits, islands mode on the bigger wild island (v2, the islands default since W1's gates, as live: scripts/ark-collide-audit.mts --fixture --wild-island kept --world v2 --hours 2 --step 4; 5,328 animals, 4,266 measured), measured on ark-next 11901a6a (2026-11-13). Until then this file measured islands mode on today's island (v1) by mistake: v2 has been islands mode's wild island since bdf8d811, so the check never saw what goes live (v1 islands there: 0 / 0 / 210 / 3,164,272). Pass-throughs and fence crossings stay at 0; cliffs (8, walks on its steeper ground) and overlaps (1,062,956: the bigger island spreads the same animals out, a third of v1's) at most today's. A change that makes them worse fails the PR; a deliberate change updates them here, with why. Then on ark-flight-physics (lane MA1, movement audit problems 1 and 3): birds fly at their cruise and take off and land at half a g, walk, wade or swim a way too short for a flight to be worth it, and fly for its own sake somewhere worth flying to (clear of their predators, in the open), so more birds stand and walk among the others for shorter flights: overlaps 1,062,956 to 1,063,555 (+0.06%); pass-throughs, fence crossings and cliffs unchanged. SPECIES-ANIM-B2 (2026-11-24, coordinator: the stable audit fixture's one-time re-baseline): each cluster now has its own slug-hash slot, so the fixture no longer moves when species are added; its new sample puts other walkers by the v2 island's steeper ground. Cliffs 3 (main with the ledge fix #118: one russian desman) to 33 in 4 animal windows, all walks and a pounce over steep ground, none a home on it: a chinese giant salamander 20 samples (ground:walk), a polar bear 6 (walk, run), an island fox 6 (a pounce: dig, walk, turn, run), a matschie's tree kangaroo 1 (walk); limit 40, not 33, because the island fox's pounce lands a different number of samples on the steep ground as species are added (38 with #112's 36 species aboard). Overlaps 890,909 to 975,648 (limit kept). Fence crossings 0. Pass-throughs 0 to 7 (limit 7): one common wall gecko (farm_garden, home 121.4, -97.3) crawls and forages as a clinger ('surface' mode) in a straight line between two ground spots, (107, -89) at 51.1 m down to (109, -111) at 36.6 m, and the line runs 0.52 m into the boulder rock:decor1205 (40.6 to 46.4 m high) at (109.9, -108.8). Main's sample never put a wall gecko there; the crawl is main's. Walking it on the ground instead (surface to ground when neither end is raised) was tried and is worse: 5 pass-throughs into the same rock plus cliffs 33 to 78, the gecko running down the 33-degree slope. A clinger's crawl that climbs over a rock in its way, rather than through it, is the follow-up; until then this limit stops anything new.
